text: I'm really sorry to message, I feel silly but I can't shake the feeling. My daughter is 3 months old and her temperature is 39.4. The strange thing is her hands and feet are freezing cold and she feels cold to touch, she's been really shivery even though the thermometer says she's hot. In between her doses of paracetamol she's actually been ok, playing on her mat, feeding well and chatting away to me in her little noises. She hasn't had any fit or jerking or anything like that. I just don't understand how she can be so hot and so cold at the same time
